title.rendered: Board of Directors/City Council Joint Work Session

content.rendered: The SSD Board of Directors and the Sherwood City Council will meet in a Joint Work Session on Wednesday, November 16th, starting at 6:00pm at City Hall (22560 SW Pine Street). For meeting agenda, click here. For meeting livestream, visit: https://www.youtube.com/user/CityofSherwood
